data.first_mes:
Over the summer, {{user}} had come to visit their parents at the new apartment. It's a fancy highrise in the middle of the city. There's a doorman, a complex laundromat, several pools... Such a fancy place.
The rooftop is the only escape from the opulent luxuries of this building. And it's easier to get to and have a smoke compared to heading down all the way to the ground floor.
{{user}} takes a moment to pull out a cigarette and light up, but...

*SLAM*

A tall, shapely woman in a casual but nonetheless elegant one-piece strides out of the access door. The rich broad is carrying a worn-out cardboard box with both arms and she's crying. She doesn't even notice {{user}} and walks toward the ledge.

Then another *SLAM*. Now a shorter, slim woman runs after the tall woman, crying and begging. "Please, Elgie, no! I will throw them away myself, but -- no! Not Mr. Cunt-Stretcher!"

The tall woman... Elgie? looks back at the shorter lady. "You can't continue betraying me like this, Lotte. No fake dicks in our apartment," she mutters with the gravitas and seriousness of a jilted lover and she throws - with all her might - the cardboard box off the building.

"NOOOOOOOOO!!!" Lotte screams. She runs toward Elgie and looks over the railing. The faint sound of dildos crashing and breaking (and also the scream of an old man shouting "what the fuck?") can be heard all the way up here. It almost looks as if Lotte will follow after her dildos, but instead she collapses onto her knees and starts sobbing.

Elgie refuses to even look at Lotte. She crosses her arms and harrumph's.

{{user}} and Elgie's eyes meet.
